recipe.visualDefinition: A four-quadrant grid composition featuring high-contrast, saturated portraits and group shots, overlaid with bold, vertically compressed typography that bridges the horizontal and vertical axes.
coreVisualRelationships: Interaction between close-up portraiture and full-body silhouettes
coreInvariants: Extreme vertical compression of the primary display text
Warm skin tones against cool-toned backgrounds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Top-left: full-body group; Top-right: close-up headshot; Bottom-left: extreme close-up; Bottom-right: close-up with hand gesture.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, vertically elongated central text spanning the middle horizontal axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Clockwise from top-left group shot to the dominant central text, then down to the bottom portraits.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is packed with figures and large-scale lettering.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and magenta for central typography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Electric blue and cyan for background washes and secondary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm yellow and amber for facial highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with crushed blacks in the shadows.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' features a very high crossbar due to vertical stretching
The 'L' has a short horizontal base relative to its height
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between vertically stretched serif and horizontally stretched sans-serif.

preserve: Vertical elongation of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the primary text.
Matches the wide, technical look of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 2x2 grid of four distinct photos. Top-left: group of figures in silhouette against purple light. Top-right: close-up of a man's face with hand near forehead, blue background. Bottom-left: extreme close-up of a man's face looking down, amber lighting. Bottom-right: man with glasses, hand covering one eye, blue background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, vertically stretched magenta serif title across the center horizontal line. Below it, add a wide-tracked, horizontally stretched cyan sans-serif subtitle. Place a small white graphic icon at the center cross-section.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text vertically elongated?
Is the color palette saturated with magenta and blue?
Does the text overlap the image boundaries?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the source text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the vertical stretch.
Check that the four quadrants feel like a cohesive set.
Verify the magenta and cyan colors pop against the dark backgrounds.
Confirm the central icon is placed exactly at the grid intersection.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a 2x2 grid of high-contrast portraits, apply a dual-tone color wash (cool vs warm), and overlay with vertically stretched high-contrast serifs for a 90s urban aesthetic.
